summary: Americas Gold & Silver filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 21, 2026 news release announcing that Chairman and CEO Paul Andre Huet will participate in Reuters' Momentum AI Austin 2026 conference on September 25 and appear on FOX Business that morning. The filing discloses no transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation, and names no advisor. It is a routine investor-communications and conference-participation disclosure with no structural or regulatory mechanics. No special-situation or risk-arb angle applies; the item carries no deal terms and no event-driven catalyst.
